parent_objective: audit the M2104 repaired artifacts before measured execution rerun command design
blocked_by: M2104 no-rollout repair must be audited before rerun command design

public_gates: M2105 must audit M2104 repaired artifact counts and claim guards
M2105 must decide whether repaired measured-execution rerun command design is admitted after required branch synthesis
M2105 must not run measured execution or rank controller families
forbidden_shortcuts: do not weaken measured runner validation
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not treat smoke proxy rows as paper-valid generated tasks

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits whether repaired artifacts are clean enough for a repaired measured execution route while respecting the branch synthesis cadence
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: repair result audit only; no rollout driver performance ranking paper or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if M2104 metadata_missing_count is nonzero
stop if eval_seed_override_count is not exactly two
stop if audit would rerun measured execution
stop if audit would rank controllers
fallback_plan: route through required branch synthesis if M2104 is clean
route to synthesis if another metadata or sampling bridge is required
route to repair redesign if seed override semantics are unsafe

training_stage.stage_objective: public-gate core measured execution repair result audit
blocked_shortcuts: do not run measured execution in audit
do not interpret repair as paper-level evidence
allowed_updates: M2105 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for required branch synthesis before repaired measured-execution command design
next_stage_criteria: next route is explicit and respects synthesis cadence

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2105 audits artifact repair and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: No history-necessity test is run in M2105.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If repair is not clean, synthesize before another local repair loop.
allowed_claims: no measured execution, controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: audits repaired artifacts before measured rerun
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can admit a repaired rerun route after synthesis but cannot change ranking or paper verdict by itself
must_synthesize_if: M2105 finds another metadata bridge is required
M2105 cannot admit rerun but proposes more local repair
M2105 proposes ranking before complete rerun audit

hypothesis: M2104's repaired artifacts are clean enough to admit a repaired public-gate measured-execution rerun route, but workflow cadence requires branch synthesis before command design.
success_criteria: M2104 summary and repaired artifacts are audited
next route is explicit and respects synthesis cadence
no reset rollout measured execution ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 claim is made
failure_criteria: new reset or rollout is performed
ranking or paper-level claims are made
